channel.title: Pier & Point · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: The February 2024 entry now says…
item.description: The February 2024 entry now says Caltrain and SFCTA were applying for about $9 million in federal funding, as reported on February 4, 2024; the report does not say when the effort began. The meeting-calendar links for SFCTA and Caltrain now point to working pages. Source: https://www.greencaltrain.com/2024/02/caltrain-and-sfcta-pursue-funding-for-22nd-street-station-accessibility/ ; https://www.sfcta.org/events ; https://www.caltrain.com/board-of-directors/meetings.

item.title: Correction · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: 22nd Street Caltrain: the FTA's…
item.description: 22nd Street Caltrain: the FTA's $14.1 million award is now dated September 2026 as an announcement (Trains.com, September 16, says it was announced 'last week'), and the summary no longer says funding is still being sought. The 2029 date is a target, not a schedule. Source: Trains.com, 2026-09-16; Railway Supply, 2026-09-12; Progressive Railroading, 2026-09-11.

item.title: Correction · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: The 22nd Street Caltrain page no…
item.description: The 22nd Street Caltrain page no longer says design is under way: SFCTA approved the design money in April 2026 but no source reports design work started. When the station would open is shown as 2029 only, because SFCTA's June 2029 and December 2029 dates and The Voice of San Francisco's "end of 2029" differ. The Board's approval is dated April 14, with final approval on April 28. Source: SFCTA Board packet, 2026-04-14 (sfcta.org/sites/default/files/2026-04/SFCTA_Board_PACKET_2026-04-14.pdf); SFCTA, 2026-04-28 (sfcta.org/blogs/98-million-sales-tax-funds-approved-support-downtown-revitalization-caltrain-station-ada); The Voice of San Francisco, 2026-10-06 (thevoicesf.org/caltrain-muni-secure-federal-grants-for-accessibility-upgrades/).

item.title: Correction · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: The 22nd Street Caltrain…
item.description: The 22nd Street Caltrain accessibility project's schedule and total cost came from an SFCTA board packet that could not be re-read. The record now follows SFCTA's own April 2026 post: design funded and expected to finish by summer 2027, with construction funding sought to finish the project by June 2029. The $19.1 million total is still listed but marked as not re-checked. Source: https://www.sfcta.org/blogs/98-million-sales-tax-funds-approved-support-downtown-revitalization-caltrain-station-ada.

item.title: Expected · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: Expected, not scheduled: the… (~2029)
item.description: Expected, not scheduled: the project is expected to open for use in 2029, subject to funding. The month differs by source: June 2029 (SFCTA's April 28, 2026 post, "seeking construction funding to implement the project by June 2029", and the April 14 presentation, "Open for use expected June 2029"), December 2029 (SFCTA's April 14 packet, project description: "have the project open for use by December 2029, subject to funding availability"; its allocation form lists "Open for Use" in April-June 2029) and "project completion by the end of 2029" (The Voice of San Francisco, October 6, 2026). Construction was not yet funded in April 2026; the FTA announced a $14.1 million award in September 2026, but no source gives a construction schedule. (~2029). Source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28; San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-14; The Voice of San Francisco, 2026-10-06.
item.source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28; San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-14; The Voice of San Francisco, 2026-10-06

item.title: Milestone · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: The Federal Transit… (~Sep 2026)
item.description: The Federal Transit Administration announces an All Stations Accessibility Program award of $14.1 million to the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board for ADA improvements at the 22nd Street station (an announced date, not a grant agreement or construction start): Trains.com, published September 16, 2026, says the agency announced the awards "last week". Railway Supply (September 12, 2026) says the FTA published its selection list on September 10 and Progressive Railroading is dated September 11; the FTA's own announcement was not read. The amount is close to the funding gap SFCTA's April 2026 plan had left as "Planned TBD". (~Sep 2026). Source: Trains.com, 2026-09-16; Railway Supply, 2026-09-12; Progressive Railroading, 2026-09-11.

item.title: Milestone · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: SFCTA Board gives final… (Apr 28, 2026)
item.description: SFCTA Board gives final approval to the $1,300,000 Prop L design-phase allocation, first approved on April 14 (one of three projects sharing a combined $9.8M Prop L allocation, alongside the Powell St Improvement and the Mission Bay Ferry Landing). SFCTA's April 28 post: "The Transportation Authority Board gave final approval at the April 28 meeting." (Apr 28, 2026). Source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28.

item.title: Expected · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: Design (PS&E… (summer 2027)
item.description: Design (PS&E, Plans/Specifications/Estimate) targeted complete; Caltrain expects to complete the design phase by summer 2027 (SFCTA, April 28, 2026). (summer 2027). Source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28; San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-14.
item.source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28; San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-14

item.title: Milestone · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: SFCTA's Transportation… (Apr 14, 2026)
item.description: SFCTA's Transportation Authority Board packet for its April 14, 2026 meeting recommends $1,300,000 in Prop L funds for the project's design phase, part of a total funding plan of $19,134,000 (Planning/Conceptual Engineering $734,000 already spent via Prop K; Design Engineering $1,300,000 via Prop L; Construction $17,100,000, an engineer's estimate at 30% design). The Board approved the allocation at that meeting (SFCTA, April 28, 2026: "During the April 14 Transportation Authority Board meeting, board members approved $9.8 million in Prop L sales tax funds"). (Apr 14, 2026). Source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-14; San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28.
item.source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-14; San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28

item.title: Milestone · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: Caltrain and SFCTA were… (~Feb 2024)
item.description: Caltrain and SFCTA were applying for federal grant funding for the station's accessibility project, seeking about $9 million from the Federal Transit Administration (Green Caltrain, February 4, 2024: "are applying for federal grant funding"; "seeking $9 million"). The month is the date of that report; the source does not say when the effort began, and it refers to a 2021 study that came before. (~Feb 2024). Source: Green Caltrain, 2024-02-04.
